additional_info.subject: 0472071 - ID0472071-DC/Si-D/AT- [Y2/T3314161484001] Door Sensor Alignment Fix CRM:00472000539
additional_info.body:
Hello Daniel,
From the video shared, the door mechanism in top and middle are not closing.
Put some paint tape in the locking and U-lock. Close the locking mechanism and close the door applying only the necessary force to mark the paint tape where both parts are touching.
The idea is to have both marks centered. You have gap in the U-lock to make adjustments. Repeat the process with new paint tape until both marks are centered.
After open again the door mechanism and try to close the door.
Push the door again and see if it's locking properly or not. If is not locking add some ISO7093 M4 washers. Max 3 washers.
After those step the door should be able to close properly.
Use a caliper to measure the gap between door and charger housing. Correct values is 5mm tolerance is +-2mm. Measure in top, middle and bottom.
I will send back this ticket to your queue but I can support remotely if you want, just send me a teams meeting for your expected time so I have availability to support.
With best regards,
